name: Progress
description: A task's steps, kept by the agents doing it: they add steps and tick them off while you watch.

commands.name: set-title
commands.description: Name the task the steps belong to.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a step at the end; answers its index.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Tick a step done, or untick it with done: false.

commands.name: list
commands.description: The title and every step, done or not.
